scripts.build: pnpm build:native && pnpm build:tsc && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-ui build && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-virtual build && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-dnd build
scripts.build:tsc: tsc -b packages/reactivity/tsconfig.json packages/di/tsconfig.json packages/validation/tsconfig.json packages/validation-vite/tsconfig.json packages/protocol/tsconfig.json packages/protocol-vite/tsconfig.json packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/vite/tsconfig.json packages/server/tsconfig.json packages/router/tsconfig.json packages/form/tsconfig.json packages/ui/tsconfig.json packages/virtual/tsconfig.json packages/dnd/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: cargo test -p silent-transform -p silent-protocol && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" --if-present test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" --if-present typecheck && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-example-counter typecheck && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-example-ssr-counter typecheck && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-example-ssr-pool typecheck && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-example-todo typecheck && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-example-router typecheck && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-example-forms typecheck && pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-bench exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.bench:build: node scripts/bench-cpus.mjs pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-bench exec tsx src/build-bench.ts
scripts.bench:hydrate: node scripts/bench-cpus.mjs pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-bench exec tsx --conditions=browser src/hydrate-bench.ts
scripts.bench:browser: node scripts/bench-cpus.mjs pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-bench exec tsx src/browser-bench.ts
scripts.bench:alloc: node scripts/bench-cpus.mjs pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-bench exec tsx src/browser-alloc.ts
scripts.bench:profile: node scripts/bench-cpus.mjs pnpm --filter @ivlev-dev/silent-bench exec tsx src/browser-profile.ts
